shared_elements: linear/geometric markings or bands on the body
justification: Both include schematic anthropomorphic imagery with simple facial features and circular/geometric markings, the closest correspondence being the use of round signs on or near a human-like body. The major difference is that A is a complex, crowded, symmetrical scene of multiple profile figures holding objects around a central emblem, while B is essentially a single frontal figure with sparse incised bands and no comparable held objects, flanking figures, or central scene.
